FILED s516a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-12): exposed when #3244 let t/020_headers.t run (it was 0 rows behind the print({$fh}) drop).

t/020_headers.t lines 34-41: header "Foo: $CRLF\x09Bar$CRLF\x09$CRLF\x09Baz$CRLF$CRLF" through HTTP::Tiny::Handle->read_header_lines must give { foo => 'Bar Baz' }; PCL's is_deeply diag reads 'HASH(0x2)' vs 'HASH(0x3)' (key counts).  Rows 1, 2, 4, 5 pass.  NOT MINIMIZED: the next step is to run read_header_lines's continuation regexes on that string under perl vs PCL (HTTP/Tiny.pm read_header_lines: the \x09/\x20 continuation branch).

Blessed row added by s516a in baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv with this cause.

=== DONE (s517a, commit 4355a492) ===
Cause: `$val = \($headers->{$field_name} = $2)` -- \ of an element ASSIGNMENT
made a ref to a fresh copy.  ExprToCL _backslash_of now emits (progn (setf
PLACE V) (p-backslash PLACE-box)) for the four element places with atom args.
020_headers.t 5/0.  Guard ref-to-ref-01.t 47 -> 48 (fails on dc87c403).
Residue: a NON-atom key/index still refs the value (it would evaluate twice).
